algebra_binding.final_v8_instance_rule: The final V8 instance equals the ratifiable payload plus a ratification object. ratification.artifact_sha256 is the ratifiable-payload SHA-256, not the final-envelope SHA-256. ratification.signature is the owner/delegate signature over the ALGEBRA_PAYLOAD domain message. The completed final V8 envelope is hashed separately and receives a detached ALGEBRA_ENVELOPE signature.
algebra_binding.review_binding: The reviewer reviews and signs the exact ALGEBRA_PAYLOAD SHA-256. The final V8 ratification.independent_semantic_reviewer.review_sha256 equals the REVIEW payload SHA-256.

canonicalization.payload_rule: Hash only the object under the exact payload key named by record_types; exclude payload_sha256 and signature wrapper fields.

record_types.ALGEBRA_ENVELOPE: completed final V8 envelope bytes after RFC8785 JCS canonicalization
